title: Flatness descends through a faithfully flat module
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a ring map and let $M$ be an $S$-module. If $M$ is flat as an $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and faithfully flat as an $S$-module [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], then $R\to S$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

mathlib_searches.query: flatness of R to S descends when an S-module is flat over R and faithfully flat over S
mathlib_searches.results: Module.FaithfullyFlat and Module.Flat exactness criteria; no theorem combining them into RingHom.Flat

mathlib_searches.query: M flat over R and faithfully flat over S implies R -> S flat
mathlib_searches.results: Module.FaithfullyFlat.iff_exact_iff_lTensor_exact and RingHom.Flat, but no permanence lemma
only separate Module.Flat and Module.FaithfullyFlat APIs; no 039V analogue
